question: What is the escalation timeline when a Severity-1 (P0) alert triggers in PagerDuty?
expected_answer: Under Section 9.1 on Page 41: 1. The L1 On-Call Engineer has a maximum of 5 minutes to acknowledge the alert. 2. If unacknowledged at 5 minutes, PagerDuty pages the L2 Staff SRE Lead. 3. If unacknowledged for 15 minutes total, it automatically escalates to the VP of Infrastructure.

question: What uptime guarantee SLA does TitanCloud provide across production clusters?
expected_answer: Under Section 2.3 on Page 9: TitanCloud guarantees a 99.95% monthly uptime Service Level Agreement (SLA) across all production multi-AZ clusters.

question: What are the service credit percentages when monthly uptime drops below thresholds?
expected_answer: Under Section 2.3 on Page 9: 99.50% to 99.94% uptime yields a 10% service credit; 99.00% to 99.49% uptime yields a 25% service credit; below 99.00% uptime yields a 50% service credit applied against the monthly cluster invoice.

question: What does the error code ERR_PG_REPLICA_LAG indicate?
expected_answer: Under Section 5.4 on Page 22: Alert Signature ERR_PG_REPLICA_LAG indicates write-ahead log (WAL) replay delay between the primary PostgreSQL node and synchronous standby replicas.

question: What is the automatic failover threshold for PostgreSQL replication lag?
expected_answer: Under Section 5.4 on Page 22: The maximum permitted replication lag threshold is strictly 45 seconds. If replication lag exceeds 45 seconds across three consecutive 5-second health probes, Patroni consensus controller automatically fences the degraded node and initiates failover to the healthy standby.

question: Who is paged if a Severity-1 incident remains unacknowledged after 15 minutes?
expected_answer: Under Section 9.1 on Page 41: If the alert remains unacknowledged for 15 minutes total (10 minutes after L2 page), it automatically escalates to the VP of Infrastructure.

question: Where must records associated with post-mortem blameless root-cause analysis be archived?
expected_answer: Under Module 25 on Page 25 (and Modules 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50): All routine records associated with post-mortem blameless root-cause analysis and action item SLAs shall be archived in the central repository at the conclusion of each operational cycle for longitudinal review.

question: What governance standard applies to distributed Kubernetes control plane telemetry under Module 1.0?
expected_answer: Under Module 1.0 on Page 1: Practitioners must ensure routine workflows adhere to documented institutional protocols and maintain verifiable audit logs across all stages of execution.
